_: Read by release.mjs. Nothing secret goes in here: the API key is the NEXUS_API_KEY environment variable.
_mod_id: The number in your own mod's URL, https://www.nexusmods.com/fieldsofmistria/mods/<this>.
_file_name: The name of the file on the Nexus page, without the version. Max 50 chars, letters digits space _ ' ( ) . - only. This one is 43, so ' V1.1.2' takes it to exactly 50 - a version part that grows to two digits will not fit, and the name has to shorten before that day.
_file_name_versioned: Sage names the file 'Farmer Outfits and Portraits - Synchronized V1.1.2', with the version on the end. So the uploaded name gets ' V<version>' appended, and the search for the file to add a version TO strips a trailing version before comparing. Without that the name never matches and every release silently creates a second download.
_update_mod_version: Whether uploading also bumps the version shown at the top of the mod page.
_archive_existing_file: Whether the previous version moves to the archived files list instead of staying visible.
